protocol.horse: Neutral70; all attributes70,480+57kg, no morale/fatigue modifiers; controlled request; no AI or traffic.
protocol.exactReference: Actual execution at60Hz from the identical full state, same route and RNG. Finite actions use integral frames; end-state/work include the final whole frame while official finish seconds are interpolated.
protocol.golden: Core factoring alone compared with published26fa9cb, every physical state and ledger at each frame. Controller and coefficient changes are excluded from this factoring check.
protocol.coarse: Finite default1/30s, tail default0.5s with0.05s response/low-reserve adaptation. Accuracy is reported against60Hz; no fitting to race results.
protocol.leader: Visible s/t/v/accel/body geometry only. Decaying observed acceleration uses1.4s response; no hidden opponent physiology or future targets. Projection is not a traffic certificate.
protocol.scope: 12 fixed solo continuations plus3 exact factoring controls; microbenchmark forecasts are counted separately, not simulated races. No real field calibration or between-horse physiological inference.

model.opponent: visible motion only; all supplied opponents propagate once per step; closest aligned wake/front; shared finite stopping/response constraint; no hidden state or full traffic certification

properties.name: Goal reachability is separate from paid energy and clipped speed
Opponent forecast uses no hidden state, bounded acceleration, and persistent epochs
Actual wake corridor is used during observed actions
Future guts, reserve, oxygen and recovery evolve instead of freezing

performance.caveat: Warmed single-process wall-time microbenchmark; not whole-race wall time or isolated CPU throughput. Other concurrent team workloads may increase the timings. Nine budget bisections and multiple finite candidates increase controller CPU.
